notes: Evaluates Stage 1 (PRD Review), Stage 2 (Post-PRD Review Meeting Sync), Stage 3 (FE Tech Design + AI Plan dual deliverables), and strict stage isolation against undefined future stages.

evals.prompt: 切回master分支，拉取下最新的master代码，然后看下 gallery文件夹下，针对 https://example.feishu.cn/wiki/<PRD_WIKI_TOKEN> 这个需求，代码的更改计划，以及需要和pm、其他端确认的点， 然后需要评论文档的点也和我check下
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 1 (PRD Review): (1) checkout master and pull origin master; (2) use lark-cli to fetch the Feishu PRD (if user token is missing, run lark-cli auth login --no-wait --json + lark-cli auth qrcode and ask user to authorize; NEVER scrape Feishu via Chrome AppleScript); (3) inspect gallery packages in codebase read-only; (4) output Code Change Plan, Points to Confirm with PM/Server/Client, and Draft Doc Comments (PM-only, no @-mentions) for user check before posting.
must_have: runs git checkout master and git pull origin master
uses lark-cli docs +fetch (or lark-cli auth login + qrcode if token missing)
inspects gallery directories in the codebase without modifying business source files
delivers 3 distinct sections: Code Change Plan, Points to Confirm (PM / Server / Client), and Draft Doc Comments (PM-only, no @mentions) for check
must_not_have: uses Chrome AppleScript to scrape Feishu doc DOM
posts comments to Feishu doc before user checks and approves them
modifies business code files during PRD review stage
conflates Stage 1 PRD review with Stage 3 Tech Design writing

evals.prompt: 这是prd评审的逐字稿，你看下 更新下问题和方案，然后live goal、中触、gallery的前端都要我们来改
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 2 (Post-PRD Review Meeting Sync): (1) read the meeting transcript and cite line ranges [Transcript Lxx-Lyy] for every decision; (2) inspect newly added packages (live-goal, giftgallery-indicator, gift-gallery-main) read-only; (3) output 3 deliverables: Key Decisions Table from the meeting, Updated Full-Scope FE Code Change Plan (with exact file paths & line numbers), and Updated Remaining Open Items (TBD). Must NOT prematurely create Feishu Tech Design docs (Stage 3).
must_have: reads the transcript and cites [Transcript Lxx-Lyy] sources for decisions
inspects all specified frontend packages (live-goal, indicator, gallery) read-only
outputs Key Decisions Table, Updated Full-Scope Code Change Plan, and Remaining TBDs
must_not_have: prematurely creates Feishu Tech Design doc before Stage 3 is triggered

evals.prompt: 用之前的前端技术方案模板开始撰写前端技术方案
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must trigger Stage 3 and produce TWO separate artifacts: (1) Human-facing Feishu Tech Design doc in my_library (bilingual CN+EN, single-language section headings, top 中文/English anchor links, Mermaid flow chart, PRD screenshots, red-highlighted TBDs, NO internal line numbers or raw code trees); (2) AI-facing <feature>-fe-plan.md saved locally in repo root AND uploaded to Feishu my_library (containing exact file paths, line numbers, step-by-step instructions, non-goals, verification commands, and QA entry test cases), linked from the Tech Design doc's Reference table and Code changes section.
must_have: creates human-facing Feishu Tech Design doc without cluttering it with line numbers or raw code file trees
writes local <feature>-fe-plan.md with exact file paths, line numbers, steps, non-goals, and test cases for AI execution
uploads <feature>-fe-plan.md to Feishu and links it inside the human-facing Feishu Tech Design doc
must_not_have: mixes internal line numbers and code trees into the human-facing tech design prose
leaves the AI-facing -fe-plan only on local disk without uploading and linking it on Feishu

evals.prompt: 我们要做 Stage 4 的流程，你按项目开发 skill 走
evals.expected_behavior: Agent must recognize that Stage 4+ is currently a placeholder in jiangjiang-project-dev and must NOT hallucinate a workflow; it should ask 疆疆 to define the exact steps for Stage 4 first.
must_have: identifies Stage 4+ as TBD / not yet defined in jiangjiang-project-dev
asks user for the exact requirements/steps before executing or codifying it
